An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''Consul-General''', predecessor to [[Consul-General]] [[Skalus]], was rumored to be one of the few Imperials allowed to set foot on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] during the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] talks regarding the [[Annexation of Asation|annexation]] of the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] world of [[Asation]].
